sentences.text: Jennifer Jason Leigh -LRB- born Jennifer Leigh Morrow on February 5 , 1962 -RRB- is an American actress .
Leigh began her career as a teenager in the 1970s , guest-starring on several television shows .
Her film breakthrough came in 1982 for her performance as Stacy Hamilton in Fast Times at Ridgemont High .	Fast Times at Ridgemont High	Fast Times at Ridgemont High

Leigh continued performing past her teen years , receiving critical praise for her roles in the 1990 films Miami Blues and Last Exit to Brooklyn .	Miami Blues	Miami Blues	Last Exit to Brooklyn	Last Exit to Brooklyn (film)

In 1991 , she appeared in Ron Howard 's Backdraft , and in 1992 she acted in the drama-thriller Single White Female .	Ron Howard	Ron Howard	Backdraft	Backdraft (film)	Single White Female	Single White Female

In 1993 , Leigh appeared in the ensemble film Short Cuts , directed by Robert Altman and , in 1994 , she starred in the Coen brothers ' The Hudsucker Proxy .	Short Cuts	Short Cuts	Robert Altman	Robert Altman	Coen brothers	Coen brothers	The Hudsucker Proxy	The Hudsucker Proxy

Leigh was nominated for a Golden Globe for her portrayal of Dorothy Parker in Mrs. Parker and the Vicious Circle -LRB- 1994 -RRB- .	Golden Globe	Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture	Dorothy Parker	Dorothy Parker	Mrs. Parker and the Vicious Circle	Mrs. Parker and the Vicious Circle
She starred in a 1995 film written by her mother , screenwriter Barbara Turner , titled Georgia .	Barbara Turner	Barbara Turner (actress)	Georgia	Georgia (1995 film)
In 2001 , she co-directed a film with Alan Cumming titled The Anniversary Party .	Alan Cumming	Alan Cumming	The Anniversary Party	The Anniversary Party
In 2002 , Leigh appeared in the crime-drama Road to Perdition .	Road to Perdition	Road to Perdition
In 2007 , she starred in Margot at the Wedding , which was directed by her then-husband , Noah Baumbach .	Noah Baumbach	Noah Baumbach	Margot at the Wedding	Margot at the Wedding
She had a recurring role on the Showtime television series Weeds as Jill Price-Gray .	Showtime	Showtime (TV network)	Weeds	Weeds (TV series)

In 2015 , she received critical acclaim for her voice-work as Lisa in Charlie Kaufman 's Anomalisa , and for her role as Daisy Domergue in Quentin Tarantino 's The Hateful Eight , for which she was nominated for the Golden Globe , Critic 's Choice , BAFTA and the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress .	The Hateful Eight	The Hateful Eight	Golden Globe	Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture	Charlie Kaufman	Charlie Kaufman	Anomalisa	Anomalisa	Quentin Tarantino	Quentin Tarantino	BAFTA	BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress
